scope: Nine exact T24.07/.08/.11 criteria and their changed-condition reference support; no other T24 leaf or independent attempt is closed

ordinary.claim: Actual nonblocking pipe read2/EAGAIN/read1/EOF with three-byte cursor; completion and EOF distinct

changed.claim: A second descriptor consumer drains readiness before the original read, which tolerates actual immediate EAGAIN

ordinary.claim: Actual bidirectional socket with retained TX buffer, EAGAIN, RX3/TX2 one-byte progress and cancellation without sending remaining byte

changed.claim: Serialized completion-event adapter validates slot generation, direction AND nonreused per-operation sequence; duplicate old completion cannot advance next submission; close waits for both target completions and a callback borrow; cancellation ACK is not completion; kernel-retained I/O tested separately

ordinary.claim: Two-success turn quota lets persistent producer and single-byte participant both advance under round-robin rotation

changed.claim: CPU-only callback uses separate work budget; no progress still consumes a callback; finite always-ready schedule is not an unconditional liveness proof

ordinary.claim: Actual LT repeats readiness after read2 of5; ET does not; explicit runnable carry drains remaining3 to EAGAIN

changed.claim: Actual EPOLLONESHOT disables notification; byte arriving after drain before MOD is reported after rearm

ordinary.claim: Actual cached slot2/gen7 event rejected before payload use after closing/unregistering and forcing descriptor-number reuse for gen8

changed.claim: Reduced generation range retires slot permanently after its final generation; stale completion cannot access new operation storage

ordinary.claim: Three-ready schedule observes per-connection2 and global8 quotas; independent ordered-list oracle covers12288 mask/cursor/work/type cells

changed.claim: Reentrant ready publication enters next turn only; nested turn rejected; snapshot and callback budget prevent recursive expansion

ordinary.claim: Actual four-connection bounded service and imported RfOutbox; three overload policies preserve rejected caller ownership and settle disconnected work

changed.claim: Variable lengths under297 independent count/byte cells; empty frames still consume slots and finite64-ID lifetime ledger rejects exhaustion

ordinary.claim: Actual32 accepted messages settle1completed/31cancelled after observed absolute deadline and callback return; repeated stop preserves one terminal per ID

changed.claim: Reentrant stop enters cancellation but retains pending message ownership AND service storage until final callback return; no asynchronous kernel-buffer release inference

ordinary.claim: Actual mutex-enrolled empty consumer/full producer/peer EOF and repeated stop; predicate-free notification rechecks condition

changed.claim: 200 actual timeout/stop races per profile plus forced timeout-first and stop-first histories; one latched mutex-arbitrated result and cleanup, no sleeps as enrollment evidence

updates.closure_rationale: Actual nonblocking pipe read2/EAGAIN/read1/EOF with three-byte cursor; completion and EOF distinct

physical_observation.state: not-observed; local hosted Linux execution only

updates.validation_method: Exact ordinary/changed native modes, independent scheduler oracle, mutex enrollment, compiled semantic/race controls and real learner export.
